facts.text: SEIS Ultra-Sensitive Seismometer was deployed at Elysium Planitia during InSight in 2018.

France's CNES Seismic Experiment for Interior Structure consists of three very-broad-band sensors sealed in an evacuated spherical vacuum chamber, sheltered under a thermal and aerodynamic Wind and Thermal Shield (WTS) dome placed directly on the soil.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
Discovered that Mars is seismically active, recording 1,319+ marsquakes, and mapped the thickness of the Martian crust and the depth of the liquid core boundary.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Elysium Planitia.
The most sensitive planetary seismometer ever built, capable of detecting vibrations smaller than the width of a single hydrogen atom.
